atoms.name: CI Green Gate
atoms.description: Wait for all required CI checks to pass before proceeding. Blocks any action that requires green CI (merges, deploys, releases).

atoms.name: Clean Main Gate
atoms.description: Verify that the main branch has a clean working tree, no uncommitted changes, and is up to date with the remote before allowing a release operation.

atoms.name: No High-Severity Vulnerabilities Gate
atoms.description: Block the pipeline if any high-severity or critical vulnerabilities were found in the dependency audit.

atoms.name: No Secrets Found Gate
atoms.description: Block the pipeline if any secrets were detected in the secret scan. Passes only when findings_count is zero.

atoms.name: No Tool Calls Gate
atoms.description: Pass when the LLM produced no tool calls in the latest response, signaling that the agentic loop should terminate and the final assistant message should be returned. Fails (blocks) when tool calls are present, indicating another iteration is required.

inputs.name: has_tool_calls
inputs.description: Output of parse-tool-calls indicating whether tool calls are present

inputs.name: iteration
inputs.description: Current loop iteration count; used in log output only

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.description: Maximum iterations allowed; gate passes when this is reached regardless of has_tool_calls

outputs.name: terminate
outputs.description: True when the loop should stop

atoms.name: Not a Major Version Bump Gate
atoms.description: Pass only when the dependency update is NOT a major version bump. Major bumps are routed for manual review.

atoms.name: Policy Broker Gate
atoms.description: Check the pending tool dispatch against the configured policy floor before allowing execution. Blocks any tool call that violates the policy; aborts the loop on violation. Implements the Olympus policy broker pattern.

inputs.name: tool_calls
inputs.description: Tool calls proposed by the LLM for this iteration

inputs.name: policy_floor_ref
inputs.description: Reference to the policy atom or config that defines allowed tool operations

inputs.name: persona_ref
inputs.description: Active persona; used to resolve persona-specific policy overrides

outputs.name: allowed
outputs.description: True when all proposed tool calls pass the policy floor

outputs.name: blocked_calls
outputs.description: Any tool calls that were blocked by policy

outputs.name: denial_reason
outputs.description: Human-readable explanation when allowed is false

atoms.name: Schema Valid Gate
atoms.description: Block the pipeline if any atoms failed schema validation. Passes only when invalid_count is zero.

atoms.name: Tests Pass Gate
atoms.description: Block the pipeline if any tests failed. Passes only when the failed count is zero.

atoms.name: Append Tool Results
atoms.description: Append tool execution results to the running message context so the next LLM invocation receives the full conversation history including all tool outputs so far.

inputs.name: tool_calls
inputs.description: Tool-call blocks from the previous assistant turn

inputs.name: tool_results
inputs.description: Results from execute-tool-calls, in matching order

outputs.name: updated_context
outputs.description: Message context with the assistant tool-call turn and tool-result turn appended

outputs.name: context_length
outputs.description: Number of messages in the updated context

atoms.name: Apply Mitigation
atoms.description: Apply a pre-approved mitigation action to reduce incident impact (rollback, feature-flag disable, traffic shift, etc.).

atoms.name: Audit Atoms
atoms.description: Walk the atoms directory and produce a report of all atom files, their types, IDs, and schema versions.

atoms.name: Build Artifact
atoms.description: Compile or bundle the project into a distributable artifact (dist/, binary, container image, etc.).

atoms.name: Clone Repository
atoms.description: Clone one or more git repositories to a local directory.

atoms.name: Cloudflare Pages Deploy
atoms.description: Deploy a built site to Cloudflare Pages using Wrangler. Requires CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

atoms.name: Deploy Catalog Site
atoms.description: Deploy the atoms catalog website (Astro/static site) to the configured hosting provider after a successful catalog build.

atoms.name: Diagnose Incident
atoms.description: Collect logs, metrics, and traces to produce a diagnostic snapshot for an active incident.

atoms.name: Execute Tool Calls
atoms.description: Dispatch each tool call in the list to the ToolExecutor and collect results. Each call is routed to the appropriate registered tool handler; results are returned in the same order as the input calls.

inputs.name: tool_executor_ref
inputs.description: Reference to the ToolExecutor instance or config

outputs.name: tool_results
outputs.description: Ordered list of tool execution results, one per input call

outputs.name: failed_calls
outputs.description: Tool calls that errored; empty on full success

atoms.name: Filter Major Version Bumps
atoms.description: Inspect a Dependabot PR and exit non-zero if the update is a major version bump, allowing the pipeline to skip or route for manual review.

atoms.name: Fix Non-Conforming Atoms
atoms.description: Apply automated or semi-automated fixes to atoms that fail schema validation. Produces a diff report of changes made.

atoms.name: Git Checkout
atoms.description: Check out a repository at a given ref. Typically the first step in any CI pipeline.

atoms.name: Git Create Tag
atoms.description: Create an annotated git tag at the current HEAD and push it to the remote. Used to mark releases.

atoms.name: Git Push
atoms.description: Push a local branch to a remote repository. Prerequisite for PR creation.

atoms.name: GitHub PR Create
atoms.description: Create a GitHub pull request from a feature branch to a target branch. Requires push access to the repository.

atoms.name: GitHub PR Merge
atoms.description: Merge a GitHub pull request using the repository's configured merge method (merge commit, squash, or rebase).

atoms.name: Install Dependencies
atoms.description: Install project dependencies from a lockfile (npm ci, pip install, go mod download, etc.).

atoms.name: Invoke LLM
atoms.description: Send the current message context and available tool schemas to the configured LLM endpoint. Returns the raw model response including any tool-call blocks.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Ordered list of messages forming the current conversation context

inputs.name: tool_schemas
inputs.description: JSON Schema definitions for tools the model may call

inputs.name: persona_ref
inputs.description: Reference to a persona atom that sets the system prompt

outputs.name: tool_calls
outputs.description: Extracted tool-call blocks from the response (may be empty)

outputs.name: final_message
outputs.description: Text content of the assistant turn (populated when no tool calls present)

atoms.name: Page On-Call
atoms.description: Send an incident page to the on-call engineer via PagerDuty, OpsGenie, or compatible alerting system.

atoms.name: Parse Tool Calls
atoms.description: Parse an LLM response object to extract structured tool-call requests. Returns an empty list when the model produced a final answer with no tool calls, signaling loop termination.

inputs.name: tool_schemas
inputs.description: Tool schemas used for validation of extracted calls

outputs.name: tool_calls
outputs.description: Validated, structured list of tool-call requests

outputs.name: has_tool_calls
outputs.description: True when at least one tool call was found; false signals loop termination

outputs.name: final_text
outputs.description: Assistant text when has_tool_calls is false

atoms.name: Regenerate Exports
atoms.description: Re-run the build-exports script to regenerate catalog.json and any other export artifacts from source atoms.

atoms.name: Run Dependency Audit
atoms.description: Audit project dependencies for known vulnerabilities (npm audit, pip-audit, cargo audit, etc.).

atoms.name: Run Lint / Validate
atoms.description: Execute linting, type-checking, and static validation steps (eslint, tsc, flake8, etc.).

atoms.name: Run Secret Scan
atoms.description: Scan the repository for leaked secrets using trufflehog or a compatible scanner. Fails if any secrets are found.

atoms.name: Run Tests
atoms.description: Execute the project test suite (unit, integration, or end-to-end). Fails the step if any test fails.

atoms.name: Setup Secrets
atoms.description: Provision developer secrets from a vault or template into the local environment (creates .env files from vault, keyring, or 1Password).

atoms.name: Sign Artifact
atoms.description: Cryptographically sign a build artifact or release archive using cosign, GPG, or sigstore.

atoms.name: Trigger Workflow
atoms.description: Dispatch a downstream workflow or pipeline (GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch, Temporal signal, etc.).

atoms.name: Upload Artifact
atoms.description: Upload a build artifact to artifact storage (GitHub Actions artifacts, S3, GCS, etc.) for downstream jobs or release.

atoms.name: Validate Schema
atoms.description: Validate a set of JSON files against one or more JSON Schema definitions. Reports all violations.

atoms.name: Write Post-Mortem
atoms.description: Generate a structured post-mortem document from the incident timeline, diagnosis, and mitigation actions.

compositions.name: Catalog Publish
compositions.description: Publish the atoms catalog: validate all atoms, build and sign the export artifact, push a release tag, and deploy the catalog website.

compositions.name: CI Validate and Build
compositions.description: Standard CI pipeline: check out the repository, install dependencies, run linting/validation, compile the build artifact, and upload it for downstream jobs.

compositions.name: Dependabot Review and Merge
compositions.description: Automatically review and merge Dependabot pull requests: filter out major version bumps for manual review, run the test suite, and merge if tests pass.

compositions.name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
compositions.description: Build a Node/Astro site and deploy it to Cloudflare Pages via Wrangler. Requires CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID in the environment.

compositions.name: Incident Response
compositions.description: Structured incident response workflow: detect and alert on-call, collect a diagnostic snapshot, apply a mitigation action, and produce a post-mortem document.

compositions.name: Olympus 8-Phase Agentic Loop
compositions.description: The core Olympus agentic execution loop. Executes up to 20 iterations of: policy-gate → invoke-LLM → parse-tool-calls → execute-tools → append-results → check-termination. Used by the Zeus toolloop and all Pantheon module orchestration.

compositions.name: Olympus Agentic Toolloop
compositions.description: The core Olympus agent loop: receive prompt → invoke LLM → parse tool calls → execute → repeat until no tool calls or max iterations reached. Gates a policy broker check before each tool dispatch.

compositions.name: Developer Onboarding
compositions.description: New developer onboarding workflow: clone all project repositories, install dependencies, run the test suite to verify the environment, and provision development secrets.

compositions.name: PR and Merge
compositions.description: Standard delivery cycle: push the feature branch, open a pull request, wait for CI to go green, then merge. Implements the full worktree+branch → push → PR → CI → merge lifecycle.

compositions.name: Release Tag
compositions.description: Tag a release: verify the main branch is clean and up to date, create an annotated git tag, then trigger the downstream release workflow.

compositions.name: Atom Schema Migration
compositions.description: Migrate atoms to a new schema version: audit existing atoms, validate them against the new schema, fix non-conforming atoms, and regenerate the catalog export.

compositions.name: Security Scan
compositions.description: Run a secret scan (trufflehog) and a dependency vulnerability audit. Gates block the pipeline if secrets are found or high-severity vulnerabilities are present.

compositions.name: SRE Incident Response
compositions.description: Full incident response lifecycle: declare → assess → mitigate → resolve → post-mortem. Uses incident-commander persona, SRE identity, and prod-read-only policy by default.

compositions.name: SRE Runbook Generation
compositions.description: Generate a structured runbook for a given service or failure mode. Uses runbook-author persona with documentation-writer voice.
